description: Write a new Notebook entry. A note is the reader's own thinking, not a saved source — save sources with create_article. Name a folder by folderId or folder (the name, resolved for you). Kind is claim, evidence or note; evidence may name the claim entry it supports.

blocks.description: Structured blocks, when you have them. Replaces content.

claimId.description: The claim entry this evidence supports. Only holds when type is evidence.

content.description: The note's text. Becomes a single paragraph block when blocks are not given.

folder.description: Notebook folder name, resolved case-insensitively. Ignored when folderId is given.

linkedArticleId.description: A Library article this note is about.

type.description: What the note is. Defaults to note.

name: create_notebook_entry
